Generally the stupidest business model I have ever witnessed in a streaming service and I had use many of them

reviews.title: Subscription First, Transparency Never
reviews.text: What a remarkable business model: hide the entire catalog, offer no trial, and expect people to subscribe anyway. Why bother showing users what they’re paying for when they can just hand over their money and hope for the best? In a market where most streaming services understand the value of transparency, this app seems determined to do the exact opposite. If the content is worth subscribing to, why treat it like a state secret?

reviews.title: Too many ads despite the subscription
reviews.text:
This is absolutely crazy that I have a vodafone subscription and watchit shows me too many ads. I must see 8 ads each 30 secs, total of 4 minutes two times per episode that is 20 minutes. 
To watch 20 minutes content I have to watch 8 minutes ads despite the premium subscription. This is absolutely crazy. 
One more thing, the picture in picture isn’t available. So I can’t do anything while I am watching like chatting on whatsapp. I can’t even access the control screen which is not that I went out from the app. So if I need to switch wifi or 4g or increase brightness from the slide down control settings, the episode must pause. For this reason this is by far the worst streaming app I have ever experienced.

reviews.title: The application is not working on my Samsung TV
reviews.text: This app is one of the worst apps ever. It suddenly stopped working on my TV several months back and whenever I run it it gives me a black screen. I tried everything, removing it , reinstalling it, deleting it and then installing it again. I tried all this several times over and over again with no chance of getting it fixed. It’s a rubbish App and using it is very frustrating. I am asking apple to remove this lousy app form it respectful store.

reviews.title: ‏لا يوجد خدمة عملاء جيدة وللأسف خدمة العملاء عندهم سيئة جدا للغاية
reviews.text:
أطلب إلغاء الاشتراك فورًا.

اشتركت بالخدمة على أساس أنها بدون إعلانات، وبعد ربطها بالتلفزيون اكتشفت أنها لا تعمل نهائيًا وتظهر رسالة فشل التحميل باستمرار.  
كما أنني حاولت التواصل معكم منذ يومين ولا أحد يرد، وهذا أمر غير مقبول لخدمة مدفوعة.

بما أن الخدمة لا تعمل وغير مطابقة لما تم الإعلان عنه، أرجو إلغاء الاشتراك فورًا.

reviews.title: Wrong Subtitles and Bad GUI experience on apple TV
reviews.text:
English subtitles are incorrect, i think someone in kinder garden is translating. No grammar, Franco Arabic and misleading translation. There is no excuse in AI era to have such low quality subtitles.

Apple TV GUI is awful. If you need to link Airpod, the application return back to login page and removing subtitle settings. Also there is no PiP for IPad or Apple products. Also it’s very challenging to navigate between episode in same series.
